detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here to support the Silver Arrows!
User Query: <event>session start</event>
User: What time does qualifying start in my local time?

expectation_details.expectation: Before stating any local (non-UTC) time, the agent asked the user for their location, city, or timezone. Giving official UTC times while asking is acceptable.
expectation_details.justification: When the user first asked for their local time, the agent provided the time in UTC and immediately asked the user for their location or timezone before providing any converted local times.

expectation_details.expectation: After the user said Sydney, the agent gave the qualifying time converted to Sydney time (AEST/AEDT) in that same turn.
expectation_details.justification: Upon receiving the input 'I'm in Sydney,' the agent correctly identified the local time for qualifying as 6 PM AEST and included this information in its response.
